caption:
Liverpool's tap water comes from a lake in Wales 💧
Lake Vyrnwy's water mostly supplies Liverpool and Cheshire. It travels through the Vyrnwy aqueduct: three pipelines with a combined length of around 153 km (95 miles), just over a metre wide. When it opened on 14 July 1892 it was the longest aqueduct in the world, and today it carries up to 210 million litres a day for over 900,000 people.
